## Build

The top-level build script is `CMakeLists.txt` at the repository root (`cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)`, `project(dde-launchpad)`).

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
sudo cmake --install build
```

## Dependencies

`Build-Depends` in `debian/control` lists 20 entries; the first 8 are listed below (see `debian/control` for the complete list):

- `debhelper-compat (= 13)`
- `cmake`
- `pkg-config`
- `libglib2.0-dev`
- `systemd`
- `qt6-base-dev`
- `qt6-base-private-dev`
- `qt6-svg-dev`

The top-level `CMakeLists.txt` looks up 3 packages with `find_package`: `QT`, `ECM`, `Qt6`.
